name: Geier-Wanderung Nationalpark Hohe Tauern
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Join a National Park Ranger on a journey to uncover the legends of the sky’s kings. This hike through the **Nationalpark Hohe Tauern** leads to the nesting sites of **Bartgeier** and **Steinadler**. With binoculars and expert explanations, you’ll observe these magnificent birds in their natural habitat.
